We propose a two-stage training approach to enhance VPL generation. First, we adopt retrieval-augmented finetuning, as VPL often reuses subroutines in similar contexts. During both training and inference, we retrieve similar examples from a corpus and incorporate them into the model input to improve generation quality. Second, we apply offline direct preference optimization (DPO) to further guide the model toward accurate outputs.
